ei.title: 2번: Why Traveling East Causes Worse Jet Lag
ei.subject: 빠른독해바른독해_구문독해_2024

fullPassage: Jet lag is a temporary sleep problem that occurs when your body's internal clock is not synchronized with the time zone that you are in. This internal clock, which is also referred to as the body's circadian rhythm, tells your body when it's time to sleep and wake up. Catching up with your new location can take varying amounts of time. Interestingly, traveling east and traveling west do not have the same effect on the body. Traveling west lengthens the body clock's experience of the normal day-night cycle. Traveling east, however, shortens one's experience of this cycle. This tends to make it more difficult for one's circadian rhythm to adjust, resulting in more serious cases of jet lag.

questions.passage: Jet lag is a (A)[temporary / permanent] sleep problem that occurs when your body's internal clock is not synchronized with the time zone that you are in. This internal clock, which is also referred to as the body's circadian rhythm, tells your body when it's time to sleep and wake up. Catching up with your new location can take varying amounts of time. Interestingly, traveling east and traveling west do not have the same effect on the body. Traveling west (B)[lengthens / shortens] the body clock's experience of the normal day-night cycle. Traveling east, however, shortens one's experience of this cycle. This tends to make it more difficult for one's circadian rhythm to adjust, resulting in more (C)[serious / minor] cases of jet lag.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) temporary=일시적 / permanent=영구적 (B) lengthens=길게 하다 / shortens=줄이다 (C) serious=심각한 / minor=사소한
det.analysis:
① permanent: 시차증은 영구적 문제? 일시적(temporary) ←②정답
② temporary—lengthens—serious: 일시적 수면 문제 + 서쪽여행은 길게 + 심각한 시차증 ←정답
③ shortens/minor: 서쪽은 길게 함 + 더 심각함
④ permanent/shortens: 둘 다 반대

questions.passage: Jet lag is a temporary sleep problem that occurs when your body's internal clock is not (A)[synchronized / disconnected] with the time zone that you are in. This internal clock, which is also referred to as the body's circadian rhythm, tells your body when it's time to sleep and wake up. Catching up with your new location can take (B)[varying / identical] amounts of time. Interestingly, traveling east and traveling west do not have the same effect on the body. Traveling west lengthens the body clock's experience of the normal day-night cycle. Traveling east, however, shortens one's experience of this cycle. This tends to make it more (C)[difficult / easy] for one's circadian rhythm to adjust, resulting in more serious cases of jet lag.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) synchronized=동기화된 / disconnected=단절된 (B) varying=다양한 / identical=동일한 (C) difficult=어려운 / easy=쉬운
det.analysis:
① disconnected: 체내시계가 시간대와 동기화되지 않을 때(not synchronized) 발생
② identical/easy: 적응 시간은 다양하고(varying) 적응이 어려움(difficult)
③ disconnected/identical: 둘 다 반대
④ synchronized—varying—difficult ←정답
det.tip: not synchronized → 시차증. 적응시간 varying. 적응 difficult

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) internal=내부의 / external=외부의 (B) same=동일한 / different=다른 (C) shortens=줄이다 / lengthens=늘리다
det.analysis:
① internal—same—shortens: 체내(internal) 시계 + 동서 여행은 같은(same) 효과 아님 + 동쪽여행은 줄인다(shortens) ←정답
② external/lengthens: 체외 시계? internal 필요. 동쪽=shortens
③ different: 'do not have the same effect' = same이 원문
④ external/shortens: external 오류
det.tip: internal clock. not the same effect. east shortens
